# @three-ws/agenc

> Client for the AgenC agent-coordination protocol on Solana — discover tasks, read task status + lifecycle, and look up the agent registry in one import.

@three-ws/agenc is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/agenc`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-agenc/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-agenc/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-agenc/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-agenc/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
